verdict.rationale: Sill is a remote-display app that streams a Mac window or desktop to an iPhone or iPad for touch, keyboard and Pencil control. It has no automation feature, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back automations is a category error for this product type. The evidence about app releases, nightly builds and going back to a prior Sill version concerns the app's own versions, not user automations, and does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
